findings.problem: On the phone (ui-home-phone, ui-exploded-phone) the toolbar row runs off the right edge. The ⋯ More button shows only as a sliver at x≈362 and the 88% mask fades it out, so Backup & fixes and Add a missing part are effectively hidden. Nothing tells the user the row scrolls.
findings.fix: Make the row fit 390px without scrolling. Move ? into #top as a 36px button at top-right (position:absolute;right:10px;top:calc(4px + env(safe-area-inset-top));pointer-events:auto). Shorten 'All parts' to 'Parts' and '👁 Full car' to '👁 Full'. Inside @media(max-width:700px) set '#tools .row{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow:visible;mask-image:none;-webkit-mask-image:none} #tools .row button{flex:1 1 auto;padding:8px 6px}'. Keep ⋯ as the last visible button.

findings.problem: When a part card is open, the part itself is not visible on the car. ui-panel-phone shows the alternator card over a solid, unexploded car at 0%, and ui-system-cooling shows none of the six cooling parts on the model. The 3D view never answers 'where is this on my car?'. select() only reveals the part when opts.reveal is set.
findings.fix: In showPanel(), always call select(m,{reveal:true}). When a system detail opens, set sysFilter=that system and setView(1), and call setT(Math.max(tTarget,0.4)). Also add a '📍 Show on car' button as the first action in the panel. It should close to a peek height ('.sheet.peek{max-height:30vh}') so the highlighted part is visible.

findings.problem: The trust signals contradict each other. The Water pump header badge says 'NUMBER NEEDS CHECKING' in mustard, but the number block below shows two green numbers labelled 'Use one of these (double-checked against a seller listing)'. In the list view, 5 of 7 engine parts show the same alarming yellow badge even when a verified replacement number exists.
findings.fix: If a part has confidence X and at least one number isn't flagged isSug/old, show the badge as 'use green number' in class cV (green), with CONF_HELP text 'Our first number was wrong; the green one below is checked'. Save the mustard 'needs checking' badge for parts with no verified alternative.

findings.problem: Old or wrong-fit numbers can still be copied. PW-425 appears under 'Old number, fits a different car' with an active copy button at 55% opacity, which makes it easy to copy and order the wrong part.
findings.fix: For .pn.old, remove the .copy span and set pointer-events:none, and move the whole block into <details><summary>Old number (don't order this)</summary>…</details>. Add the CSS '.pn.old{text-decoration:line-through}'.

findings.problem: Part titles and tips lead with catalog jargon a non-mechanic can't use. Examples: 'Alternator 110A (Lester 8260)', 'Tip: Lester 8260 for this car, not 8418 or 8406', 'runs off the serpentine belt, not the timing belt', 'Zetec'.
findings.fix:
Show p.name with parentheses stripped as the h2, i.e. 'Alternator'. Put the spec on a muted line under it: '
110-amp · Lester 8260
'. In tips, replace part numbers with 'see Part numbers below'. On first use, wrap 'serpentine belt' and 'Zetec' in a gloss chip (the .how .chip style) that opens a one-line definition from the Help glossary.

findings.problem: The system names and the My car quick facts are unglossed jargon. Examples: 'HVAC' as a system name; 'The PCM reads the coolant temperature sensor'; 'coolant degas bottle'; 'DOHC 16v Zetec-E, 130 hp / 135 lb-ft, VIN code 3'; 'MTX-75 … 4F27E'; 'ZTW'; 'ABS+traction'.
findings.fix: Rename the HVAC system label to 'Heat & A/C'. Write 'PCM (engine computer)' and 'degas bottle (coolant overflow tank)'. In the vehicle facts, put plain English first and the codes second in .muted, e.g. 'Engine: 2.0-liter 4-cylinder, 130 hp DOHC Zetec-E, VIN code 3' and 'Transmission: 5-speed stick or 4-speed automatic MTX-75 / 4F27E'.

findings.problem: On the phone the only instruction text is hidden (#top .sub{display:none}). The one visible hint says 'scroll wheel = explode dial', which is desktop wording. The car fills about 250×110px of a 390×844 screen with roughly 350px of empty ground below it, so 'tap a part' is neither explained nor easy to do after the coach is dismissed.
findings.fix: In @media(max-width:700px), replace #hint's text with 'Tap any part · pinch or slide to pull apart' and show it until the first select(), with no pointer:coarse hiding. Set camera.position to about (14,7,17) when innerWidth<700 and controls.target.y to 1.6 so the car fills the width and sits lower in the frame.

findings.problem: In the exploded phone view (ui-exploded-phone, 60%) dozens of parts sit inside a ~250×150px cluster. Most are only a few pixels across, which makes it hard to hit a specific part like a sensor or filter with a finger.
findings.fix: On coarse pointers, fall back to the nearest part: if the ray misses, pick the mesh whose projected centre is within 24px of the tap. After a tap, briefly show #tag with the part name at the touch point (tag.style.display='block' for 1.2s) so the user can confirm before the sheet covers the view. Also auto-dolly the camera closer (distance ×0.75) when tTarget>0.3 on phones.

findings.problem: The '👁 Full car' button shows the current state, not what it does. A layperson won't guess that tapping it cycles through three modes. Help needs a whole row to explain 'tap to cycle Full car → See inside → Parts only'.
findings.fix:
Replace it with a 3-segment control, '
', with .on on the active segment. Alternatively, label the button with the next action: 'See inside ›' / 'Parts only ›' / 'Full car ›'.

findings.problem: The three action buttons are different element types and misalign. In the desktop panel, 'Prices online' sits about 2px higher and has a different border and text colour from 'Buy nearby', and 'Buy nearby' looks disabled next to the orange primary. On the phone 'Buy nearby' is a plain grey button, although buying locally is a core goal.
findings.fix: Render all three as <button> in '.chips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr}' with 'button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px}'. Give Buy nearby the same orange text and border as Prices online, or make 'Watch how-to' and 'Buy nearby' both .pri.

findings.problem: The disclosures that hide important numbers ('Other numbers that fit (2)', 'Details for the parts counter', 'All specs') are 12px #9a9a9a summaries about 20px tall. They are hard to spot and hard to tap.
findings.fix: 'details summary{min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--or2)} details summary::marker{content:""} details summary::before{content:"▸ ";} details[open] summary::before{content:"▾ "}'

findings.problem: The system cards and the 'Works together with' cards have no tap affordance: no chevron, and a grey border like static text. On the phone, only the '7 parts' pill hints that they're interactive.

The system filter chips in the All parts list overflow on the phone ('Ignition & Elec' is cut off) with no fade or arrow. There are 14 systems, but only 4.5 chips are visible and there's no hint the row scrolls.
findings.fix: Add the same mask used on #tools .row to the chip row: '.chips{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 85%,transparent)}'. Alternatively, on the phone use flex-wrap:wrap with smaller chips (padding:6px 10px;font-size:12.5px) so all 14 show in 3–4 rows.

findings.problem: Backup & fixes spends the top of the sheet on three dt/dd pairs that each read '0'. The red 'Erase all my fixes' and the jargony 'Copy backup text' are shown even when there is nothing to back up or erase.
findings.fix: Replace the three counts with one line: n?`${fixed} fixed · ${added} added · ${removed} removed`:'No fixes yet — nothing to back up.'. Hide Save, Copy and Erase when n===0 and leave only 'Restore a backup'. Rename 'Copy backup text' to 'Copy backup (to paste in a note or email)'.

findings.problem: Several labels don't match. The button says 'My car' but the sheet title says 'This car'. The Help sheet says More (⋯) contains 'this help', but help is the separate ? button. The Help hint row mentions 'scroll wheel' on phones.
findings.fix: Title the vehicle sheet 'My car'. Change the Help row to 'More (⋯) — Backup & fixes, Add a missing part' and add a separate row, '? — this help'. On coarse pointers, render the Explode row as 'or pinch with two fingers'.

findings.problem: On desktop the open sheet (440px, right side) covers the front third of the car. The camera isn't offset (setViewOffset only runs for innerWidth<=700), so the headlamp and engine-bay area sit behind the panel in ui-panel-desk and ui-systems-desk.
findings.fix: In open(), for innerWidth>700 call camera.setViewOffset(innerWidth,innerHeight,Math.min(460,innerWidth*0.54)/2,0,innerWidth,innerHeight) to shift the scene left by half the sheet width.

findings.problem: On desktop the 'All systems' <select> duplicates the Systems button and the list chips. Because #tools is only 300px wide, ? and ⋯ wrap onto a lonely second row.
findings.fix: Remove #sysf on desktop too ('#tools select{display:none}' globally), or widen #tools to 360px so ?, ⋯ and the other buttons stay on one row.

findings.problem: In the list, the 'number needs checking' (cX, #5a4a1a/#ffe3a0) and 'best guess, check first' (cL, #4a2f1a/#ffd3a8) badges are nearly the same brown-yellow. The five trust levels are hard to tell apart at 11px.
findings.fix: Add a leading glyph to each badge: V '✓ ', K '📘 ', L '? ', C '👤 ', X '⚠ '. Change cL to a neutral outline style: '.cL{background:transparent;border:1px solid #8a5a2a;color:#ffd3a8}'.

keep: Explode slider labelled 'EXPLODE / pull the car apart' with a big 28px thumb and a % readout: clear and thumb-friendly
Phone bottom sheet at 66vh with a grab handle and 44px ×, and the car stays visible above
Part card leads with plain-English 'what it does' and then a 'When it's going:' symptom line in a distinct colour
Difficulty dots with 'weekend job, jack + torque wrench', which is concrete for a layperson
Full-row part-number buttons (44px) with 'Tap a number to copy it' and a green border on the one to use
The green REFRESHER boxes and the inline tappable part chips in 'How it works on this car' on system pages
'Works together with' cards that explain how systems interact in one sentence
Help sheet's trust-badge legend and 'Words you will see' glossary
My car 'Help finish this' prompt telling the owner exactly which sticker to photograph and why
Editing tools (Backup, Add part) tucked behind ⋯, so the main path stays read-only
Local store cards with big Directions / Call buttons
Back button closes sheets through the history API
